summary: Spoolman is a self-hosted application designed to track physical inventories of 3D-printer filament spools. It helps you record remaining weights, material types, colours, and locations to prevent running out of material mid-print. The software acts as a centralised ledger for workshop consumables.
goodFor: Makers and small print farms who need a dedicated database to manage multiple filament rolls across various printers.
watchOut: It addresses a very niche operational problem, meaning it will likely require manual data entry and may not integrate with your existing general inventory systems.
deployNotes: As a Dockerised Python application, it will typically require a persistent volume mounted for database storage and an external reverse proxy if you require TLS termination.
